latestVersion.changelog:
Highlight Editor App 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly extract and export video highlights from long recordings by simply describing what you want.
- Automatic API setup with secure token generation for anonymous or authenticated use.
- Upload video files (up to 500MB), describe highlight selections, and receive 1080p MP4 highlight reels within minutes.
- Supports credits and session state management, including real-time cloud-based rendering on GPU nodes.
- Clear error handling for common file and session issues; actionable user guidance provided.
- Flexible input routing: prompts for export, credits, uploads, and edits are mapped to matching workflows.
